title: 第13章 三品武魂第14章 剑势
content_zh:
“一共一百零三枚淬体丹。”
回到少主府，秦浩清点了下战利品，双眸微微放光。
柳若杰贡献最多，十二枚淬体丹，其次是陈江，有十枚，余下的便是陈林山和其他几名柳家子弟。
再加上秦浩自己的五十八枚，一共一百零三枚淬体丹！
这么多淬体丹，放在天水城任何势力，都是一笔巨款！
“这些丹药，应该足够我冲击三品武魂了吧！”
秦浩笑了一声，随即有些迫不及待。
更让他期待的是，突破三品武魂后，或许，可以尝试进入剑塔第二层。
自从在剑塔第一层得到《大道夺灵诀》，他无数次尝试进入第二层，可惜，仿佛有无形力量阻挡，每次都以失败告终。
“剑塔第一层就有《大道夺灵诀》这种上古功法，不知道第二层会有什么？”
而且，剑塔共有九层。
秦浩压下心思，打开水晶瓶，取出一枚淬体丹，张口便吞了下去。
《大道夺灵诀》运转！
与此同时，金色小剑剑魂也缓缓浮现胸前！
嗡！
仅仅一个呼吸，一枚淬体丹炼化完毕，秦浩没有停顿，又取出一枚。
五枚。
十枚！
……
五十八枚！

当秦浩炼化到第六十三枚淬体丹时，突然，面前的金色小剑剧烈震荡起来，一抹璀璨金光绽放，整个房间被照耀的宛如烈日当空。
这股光芒，甚至穿透房间，照耀在少主府外。
不过，仅仅刹那，金光迅速收敛，金色小剑归于平静。
而此时，金色小剑剑魂，已然增长了数公分，距离一米之长，又接近了些许。
“三品武魂，晋级成功了！”
秦浩狂喜。
足足炼化了一百六十三枚淬体丹，武魂终于成功晋级三品！
二品武魂，配合《大道夺灵诀》，吸收天地灵气的速度已经十分之快。
三品武魂，又将达到什么样的地步？
秦浩深吸口气，没有立即尝试修炼，而是继续把余下的淬体丹，全部炼化完毕。
只不过，这一次，炼化了余下全部淬体丹，武魂也没有太大的变化。
见此情形，秦浩瞠目结舌，“二品晋级三品，一共用了一百六十三枚淬体丹，是一品晋级二品八倍的量，若是三品晋级四品，只怕耗费的淬体丹，得用千枚来计算。”
摇摇头，秦浩没有深思，虽然随着武魂晋级，耗费的丹药会越来越庞大，但他并不担心。
届时，他的实力提升，赚取丹药的途径也会更多。
content_en:
"A total of one hundred and three body tempering pills."
Returning to the Young Master's Mansion, Qin Hao counted the trophies, his eyes shining slightly.
Liu Ruojie contributed the most, with twelve Body Tempering Pills, followed by Chen Jiang with ten, and the rest were Chen Linshan and several other Liu family disciples.
In addition to Qin Hao's own fifty-eight, there are a total of one hundred and three body tempering pills!
So many body tempering pills would be a huge sum of money for any force in Tianshui City!
"These pills should be enough for me to attack the third-level martial spirit!"
Qin Hao laughed and then became impatient.
What made him even more looking forward to it was that after breaking through to the third level martial soul, he might be able to try to enter the second level of the sword tower.
Ever since he obtained the "Great Way to Seize Spirit" on the first floor of the sword tower, he has tried countless times to enter the second floor. Unfortunately, there seemed to be invisible forces blocking his way, and he failed every time.
"On the first floor of the sword tower, there is an ancient technique like the "Great Way to Seize Souls". I wonder what will be on the second floor?"
Moreover, the sword tower has nine floors.
Qin Hao suppressed his thoughts, opened the crystal bottle, took out a body tempering pill, opened his mouth and swallowed it.
"The Great Way to Seize Soul" is in operation!
At the same time, the spirit of the golden little sword slowly emerged from his chest!
Buzz!
In just one breath, a body tempering pill was refined. Qin Hao took out another one without stopping.
Five.
Ten!
…
Fifty-eight!
When Qin Hao had refined the sixty-third body tempering pill, suddenly, the golden sword in front of him vibrated violently, and a bright golden light bloomed, illuminating the entire room like the scorching sun in the sky.
This light even penetrated the room and shone outside the young master's mansion.
However, in just an instant, the golden light quickly converged, and the golden sword returned to calm.
At this time, the golden sword spirit had grown a few centimeters, and was now a meter away, and was a little closer.
"Third-grade martial spirit, promotion was successful!"
Qin Hao was ecstatic.
After refining a total of one hundred and sixty-three body tempering pills, the martial spirit finally successfully advanced to the third level!
The second-grade martial soul, combined with the "Great Spirit Seizing Technique", can absorb the spiritual energy of heaven and earth very quickly.
What level will the third-grade martial spirit reach?
Qin Hao took a deep breath and did not try to practice immediately. Instead, he continued to refine all the remaining body tempering pills.
However, this time, after refining all the remaining body tempering pills, the martial soul did not change much.
Seeing this situation, Qin Hao was dumbfounded, "To advance from the second level to the third level, a total of one hundred and sixty-three Body Tempering Pills were used, which is eight times the amount required to advance from the first level to the second level. If the third level is promoted to the fourth level, I am afraid that the consumed body tempering pills will be calculated in thousands."
Shaking his head, Qin Hao did not think deeply. Although as the martial soul advanced, the elixirs consumed would become larger and larger, but he was not worried.
By then, his strength will increase and there will be more ways to earn elixirs.
